notes.title: Update 1.2: Endless Mode
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257157/a50da458f0d012032fafeed25c8577082e27588e.png"]





Greetings, Necrotypers!

Update 1.2 comes with a heap of bug fixes and improvements, and also introduces two new Endless levels. Survive waves of enemies by building defensive structures. After each wave, you are rewarded with a perk that further increases your power. Levels can be accessed on the world map once you’ve progressed far enough into the game.


[previewyoutube=QwNoy2m5Cn8;full][/previewyoutube]


🛡️ Endless Mode


 Added a new Endless Mode, where you fend off waves of enemies.


 Buy towers, earn perks, and survive for as long as possible.


 Two Endless levels have been added to the map. They unlock once you've progressed far enough in the game. Try to survive as many waves as you can!



📖 Spellbook Improvements


 Spell descriptions are now more detailed.


 Spells that summon skeletons now display the stats of those skeletons.


 Items previously listed in the spellbook's Item section have been moved under their respective skeleton units.


 Various UI and UX tweaks.


 Numerous gameplay bug fixes.



🛠️ Bug Fixes & Other Improvements


 Fixed an issue where the Perfectionist achievement sometimes wouldn’t be detected (applies to older save games as well).


 Improved skeleton formation logic.


 Fixed issues with overlapping text.


 Improved intro and outro cutscenes.


 Enhanced combat sound effects.


 Improved UX when discovering new items.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Difficulty modes

Difficulty of the level can now be selected on the world map.
 Difficulty level now impacts not only the length of words, but also how much focus you lose on a mistype and the spawn rate of enemies.


Misc. Changes

Increased damage and armor penetration for higher-tier ranged weapons.
Significantly reduced the cost of all spell upgrades.
Spell book page buttons now appear when previous or next pages are available.


Fixes

Significant performance improvements in certain levels by adjusting foliage quality and density.
Replaced grass for better performance and visual quality.
Automatic quality detection when first starting the game.
Quality settings should now save correctly.
Fixed an issue in the "Toll House" level where a tutorial window would get stuck and prevent the player from progressing.
Added missing icons and names for items.
Fixed a bug where skeletons would get stuck on the siege tower.
Fixed a bug where Crush spell visual effect would remain once triggered.
Fixed a soul counter at the top of the spellbook.
Fixed an issue on macOS, where directional keys would be detected as letter input.
Creating a new save game profile now immediately selects it.
Fixed a bug in cinematics, where text writing would ignore the last letter.
